mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower rates predict positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and 20-day returns are negative in <= 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 192.0 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 192.0 and 20-day returns are negative in <= 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.5%, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market stress with monetary easing
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.5 and 20-day returns are positive in <= 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2200 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 350000, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2200 AND RSAFS > 350000 and 20-day returns are positive in <= 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is positively related to S&P 500 forward returns: higher starts predict positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: HOUST < 2100 and 60-day returns are negative in <= 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115.0 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 115.0 and 5-day returns are negative in <= 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the employment level (PAYEMS) falls below 132000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5%, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 132000 AND UNRATE > 5.5 and 60-day returns are negative in <= 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 3.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 192.0, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 192.0 and 5-day returns are negative in <= 60% of cases.
